newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's central bank chief did not quit - aide.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's central bank chief did not quit - aide.

text.p: Ecuador's Central Bank chief, Fidel Jaramillo, has not offered his resignation as newspapers reported Thursday, an aide said.
"The manager has not presented his resignation. He remains in his post," the aide said in referring to Jarmillo, whose official title is general manager of the central bank of Ecuador.
Newspaper reports said all of the members of the economic team of President Fabian Alarcon presented their resignations over differences in economic policy.
Finance Minister Carlos Davalos said earlier Thursday he had offered his resignation to the president but that Alarcon had not decided yet whether to accept it.

Since a referendum at the end of May approved of Alarcon's mandate after the ousting of former President Abdala Bucaram earlier in the year, several members of the government have offered their resignations as a goodwill gesture to give Alarcon a free hand in chosing ministers.
Davalos, Jaramillo and Monetary Board President Danilo Carrera left for Washington to meet with International Monetary Fund officials.
